paragraphs.text:
Instinctively, you retreat toward the cover of the house. You turn 
to run, but you aren’t quick enough. As you enter the doorway, 
Joshua fires his gun and you take a bullet in the back. You feel it 
tear through you and see the projectile pass out the other side. 
You collapse to the floor.

You reach down to clutch your wound, staring at your bloody 
hand in disbelief. You look up to find Joshua standing over you. He 
raises his gun at you. For a brief and terrible moment, you anticipate 
the end of your life, but Amelia shrieks. Joshua curses under his 
breath and kicks you in the face. You slip into unconsciousness.
